nodes.name: power_5v_buck
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_12V (or VIN_24V) down to VCC_5V for logic supply. EN tied high for always-on; feedback VSENSE/COMP network ensures regulation; PH pin outputs switching node for inductor. Requires external inductor, output capacitors, and compensation network. Provides VCC_5V to downstream modules.

nodes.name: PH

nodes.name: power_3v3_ldo
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator steps VCC_5V down to VCC_3V3 for MCU and peripherals. Vin from VCC_5V, output provides VCC_3V3. Requires input/output bypass capacitors. Provides VCC_3V3 to downstream modules.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 ARM Cortex-M3 MCU. Connected to two TMC2209 via UART (addresses set via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 pins). Connected to W25Q64JV via SPI for motion parameter storage. Requires external crystal, BOOT0 held low for Flash boot, NRST pull-up, and UART/USART pins configured. Owns pull-up resistors for SPI and UART lines. SPI chip-select per peripheral.

nodes.name: stepper_driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 stepper driver for channel A. VCC_IO=5V, motor supply from VIN_12V/VIN_24V. UART communication via PDN_UART/CLK pins (requires external RC circuit). STEP and DIR inputs for basic control; DIAG output open-drain (requires pull-up) for fault indicator; address set via MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 pins tied high/low. VREF pin sets current reference via potentiometer. Motor coils connect to OA1/OA2/OB1/OB2.
